title: mcp: verify_build and create_metadata do not surface a publish-time refusal (an unsupported autonumber format) before publish
body:
domain:server#6 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnTcb4cZVkPdhkPicW

Carries the "Secondary" item of #32396; #32396 keeps its main defect, fixed by PR #32454 (`Fixes #32396`). The seat splits this item off so it is not lost when that PR closes the card.

Filing gate: ① product defect, reported on a public entry (MCP, ObjectOS Cloud os-test, 2026-11-11, #32396's reporter).
reach: public entry, measured by #32396's reporter over MCP. ⚠ First step: re-measure in-repo on `main`.

## What happened (from #32396, verbatim)

> The bad autonumber format was staged through MCP `create_metadata(type: object)` → `status: drafted` with no warning, and MCP `verify_build` then answered `errors: 0` ("structurally clean"). The `lint-autonumber-formats` rule is only enforced at publish. That is the save-vs-publish verdict parity #26707 / #26856 closed, but `verify_build` (and the create_metadata result) still do not surface it.

## Expected

A rule that refuses at publish is reported by `verify_build`, and on the `create_metadata` result as a warning, before publish. That is the same verdict parity #26707 / #26856 established for the save door.

## Business reason

Who: AI builders and admins authoring over MCP. Without it, they are told the build is clean and only learn of the refusal at publish, after other work depends on it.

## Reader

Triage first touch. The fix likely lands in the MCP `verify_build` / `create_metadata` paths (`packages/mcp`, metadata-protocol's verdict).

## Duplicate check

`gh api search/issues`, `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue`, open and closed, 2026-11-11: `verify_build autonumber refusal publish` 2 hits, #32396 (the parent) and #6015 (a seat post). No card for this.
